text: Tiffany D. Jackson's Grown was banned in school districts in three states in 2022. In September 2022 the Clay County School District in Florida banned it pending investigation. In October 2022 the Frisco Independent School District in Texas banned it from libraries and classrooms, while the Beaufort County School District in South Carolina and Escambia County Public Schools in Florida banned it pending investigation.
